from decimal import Decimal, ROUND_FLOOR, ROUND_HALF_UP

# ==========================================
# CONSTANTS SECTION
# ==========================================

# Sec 16(ia) - Standard deduction amounts
STD_DEDUCTION_OLD = Decimal('50000')  # Sec 16(ia)
STD_DEDUCTION_NEW = Decimal('75000')  # Sec 115BAC proviso

# Sec 24(b) - Self-occupied house property interest limit (Old regime)
HP_INTEREST_LIMIT = Decimal('200000')  # Sec 24(b)

# Sec 80C - Aggregate limit (Old regime)
SEC_80C_LIMIT = Decimal('150000')  # Sec 80C read with Sec 80CCE

# Sec 80CCD(1B) - Additional NPS limit (Old regime)
SEC_80CCD_1B_LIMIT = Decimal('50000')  # Sec 80CCD(1B)

# Sec 80D - Health insurance limits (Old regime)
SEC_80D_SELF_NON_SENIOR = Decimal('25000')  # Sec 80D(i)
SEC_80D_SELF_SENIOR = Decimal('50000')  # Sec 80D(i) senior citizen
SEC_80D_PARENTS_NON_SENIOR = Decimal('25000')  # Sec 80D(ii)
SEC_80D_PARENTS_SENIOR = Decimal('50000')  # Sec 80D(ii) senior citizen

# First Schedule, Part III, Para A - Old Regime Slabs: (lower, upper, rate)
SLABS_OLD_UNDER_60 = [
    (Decimal('0'), Decimal('250000'), Decimal('0')),
    (Decimal('250000'), Decimal('500000'), Decimal('0.05')),
    (Decimal('500000'), Decimal('1000000'), Decimal('0.20')),
    (Decimal('1000000'), None, Decimal('0.30')),
]

SLABS_OLD_SENIOR = [
    (Decimal('0'), Decimal('300000'), Decimal('0')),
    (Decimal('300000'), Decimal('500000'), Decimal('0.05')),
    (Decimal('500000'), Decimal('1000000'), Decimal('0.20')),
    (Decimal('1000000'), None, Decimal('0.30')),
]

SLABS_OLD_SUPER_SENIOR = [
    (Decimal('0'), Decimal('500000'), Decimal('0')),
    (Decimal('500000'), Decimal('1000000'), Decimal('0.20')),
    (Decimal('1000000'), None, Decimal('0.30')),
]

# Sec 115BAC(1A)(iii) - New Regime Slabs: (lower, upper, rate)
SLABS_NEW = [
    (Decimal('0'), Decimal('400000'), Decimal('0')),
    (Decimal('400000'), Decimal('800000'), Decimal('0.05')),
    (Decimal('800000'), Decimal('1200000'), Decimal('0.10')),
    (Decimal('1200000'), Decimal('1600000'), Decimal('0.15')),
    (Decimal('1600000'), Decimal('2000000'), Decimal('0.20')),
    (Decimal('2000000'), Decimal('2400000'), Decimal('0.25')),
    (Decimal('2400000'), None, Decimal('0.30')),
]

# Sec 87A - Rebate thresholds and limits
REBATE_INCOME_LIMIT_OLD = Decimal('500000')  # Sec 87A (old)
REBATE_MAX_OLD = Decimal('12500')  # Sec 87A (old)
REBATE_INCOME_LIMIT_NEW = Decimal('1200000')  # Sec 87A (new)
REBATE_MAX_NEW = Decimal('60000')  # Sec 87A (new)

# First Schedule - Surcharge thresholds, rates, and base rates
SURCHARGE_THRESHOLDS = [
    Decimal('5000000'),    # 50 Lakh
    Decimal('10000000'),   # 1 Crore
    Decimal('20000000'),   # 2 Crore
    Decimal('500000000'),  # 5 Crore (Old regime only)
]

SURCHARGE_RATES_OLD = [
    Decimal('0.10'),
    Decimal('0.15'),
    Decimal('0.25'),
    Decimal('0.37'),
]

SURCHARGE_RATES_NEW = [
    Decimal('0.10'),
    Decimal('0.15'),
    Decimal('0.25'),
    Decimal('0.25'),
]

# Health and Education Cess
CESS_RATE = Decimal('0.04')  # Health and Education Cess


# ==========================================
# HELPER FUNCTIONS
# ==========================================

def round_nearest_ten(amount: Decimal) -> Decimal:
    """Sec 288A/288B: Floor to whole rupees, then round to nearest ten."""
    whole = amount.quantize(Decimal('1'), rounding=ROUND_FLOOR)
    return (whole / Decimal('10')).quantize(Decimal('1'), rounding=ROUND_HALF_UP) * Decimal('10')


def compute_slab_tax(taxable_income: Decimal, slabs: list[tuple[Decimal, Decimal | None, Decimal]]) -> tuple[Decimal, list[tuple[str, Decimal, str]]]:
    total_tax = Decimal('0')
    trace_lines = []
    for lower, upper, rate in slabs:
        if taxable_income <= lower:
            break
        if upper is None or taxable_income <= upper:
            taxable_in_slab = taxable_income - lower
        else:
            taxable_in_slab = upper - lower

        slab_tax = taxable_in_slab * rate
        total_tax += slab_tax
        if slab_tax > 0:
            upper_str = str(upper) if upper is not None else "above"
            clause = "First Schedule, Part III, Para A" if slabs[0][1] in (Decimal('250000'), Decimal('300000'), Decimal('500000')) else "Sec 115BAC(1A)(iii)"
            desc = f"Tax at {rate * 100}% on slab {lower} to {upper_str}"
            trace_lines.append((desc, slab_tax, clause))
    return total_tax, trace_lines


def calculate_regime(
    is_new: bool,
    inp: dict
) -> tuple[int, int, list[dict]]:
    gross_salary = Decimal(str(inp['gross_salary']))
    age = int(inp['age'])
    hra_received = Decimal(str(inp['hra_received']))
    basic_plus_da = Decimal(str(inp['basic_plus_da']))
    rent_paid = Decimal(str(inp['rent_paid']))
    rent_city_is_metro = bool(inp['rent_city_is_metro'])
    home_loan_interest = Decimal(str(inp['home_loan_interest']))
    sec_80c = Decimal(str(inp['sec_80c']))
    sec_80ccd_1b = Decimal(str(inp['sec_80ccd_1b']))
    health_ins_self = Decimal(str(inp['health_ins_self']))
    health_ins_parents = Decimal(str(inp['health_ins_parents']))
    parents_senior = bool(inp['parents_senior'])

    trace = []

    # 1. Gross Salary (Sec 17(1))
    trace.append({
        "kind": "income",
        "description": "Gross salary",
        "amount": str(gross_salary),
        "clause": "Sec 17(1)"
    })

    current_salary = gross_salary

    # 2. Standard Deduction (Sec 16(ia))
    if is_new:
        std_dedn = min(current_salary, STD_DEDUCTION_NEW)
        std_clause = "Sec 16(ia) read with Sec 115BAC"
    else:
        std_dedn = min(current_salary, STD_DEDUCTION_OLD)
        std_clause = "Sec 16(ia)"

    current_salary -= std_dedn
    trace.append({
        "kind": "income",
        "description": "Standard deduction",
        "amount": str(-std_dedn),
        "clause": std_clause
    })

    # 3. HRA Exemption (Sec 10(13A) read with Rule 2A) - Old regime only
    if not is_new and hra_received > 0 and rent_paid > 0:
        rent_excess = rent_paid - (Decimal('0.10') * basic_plus_da)
        if rent_excess > 0:
            percentage = Decimal('0.50') if rent_city_is_metro else Decimal('0.40')
            limit_c = percentage * basic_plus_da
            hra_exempt = min(hra_received, rent_excess, limit_c)
            if hra_exempt > 0:
                current_salary -= hra_exempt
                trace.append({
                    "kind": "income",
                    "description": "HRA exemption",
                    "amount": str(-hra_exempt),
                    "clause": "Sec 10(13A)"
                })

    # 4. Income from house property / loss set-off (Sec 24(b) and Sec 71(3A)) - Old regime only
    if not is_new and home_loan_interest > 0:
        hp_loss = min(home_loan_interest, HP_INTEREST_LIMIT)
        if hp_loss > 0:
            current_salary -= hp_loss
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "Loss from self-occupied house property set off",
                "amount": str(-hp_loss),
                "clause": "Sec 24(b) and Sec 71(3A)"
            })

    # Ensure Gross Total Income is not negative
    if current_salary < 0:
        current_salary = Decimal('0')

    gti = current_salary

    # 5. Chapter VI-A Deductions (Old regime only)
    total_deductions = Decimal('0')
    if not is_new:
        # Sec 80C (capped at SEC_80C_LIMIT)
        ded_80c = min(sec_80c, SEC_80C_LIMIT)
        if ded_80c > 0:
            total_deductions += ded_80c
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "Deduction under Section 80C",
                "amount": str(-ded_80c),
                "clause": "Sec 80C"
            })

        # Sec 80CCD(1B) (capped at SEC_80CCD_1B_LIMIT)
        ded_80ccd = min(sec_80ccd_1b, SEC_80CCD_1B_LIMIT)
        if ded_80ccd > 0:
            total_deductions += ded_80ccd
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "Deduction under Section 80CCD(1B)",
                "amount": str(-ded_80ccd),
                "clause": "Sec 80CCD(1B)"
            })

        # Sec 80D
        limit_self = SEC_80D_SELF_SENIOR if age >= 60 else SEC_80D_SELF_NON_SENIOR
        ded_self = min(health_ins_self, limit_self)

        limit_parents = SEC_80D_PARENTS_SENIOR if parents_senior else SEC_80D_PARENTS_NON_SENIOR
        ded_parents = min(health_ins_parents, limit_parents)

        ded_80d = ded_self + ded_parents
        if ded_80d > 0:
            total_deductions += ded_80d
            trace.append({
                "kind": "income",
                "description": "Deduction under Section 80D",
                "amount": str(-ded_80d),
                "clause": "Sec 80D"
            })

        # Sec 80A(2) cap: total deductions cannot exceed Gross Total Income
        if total_deductions > gti:
            excess = total_deductions - gti
            total_deductions = gti
            # Adjust trace or add capping note if needed, but standard tracing applies
            # Here we can simplify by ensuring total income reduction matches GTI cap if exceeded
            # But let's correctly reflect the net deductions applied
            # To be precise, let's re-apportion or adjust the trace lines if GTI < total_deductions
            # Actually, standard implementation: cap total deductions at GTI. Let's adjust trace if total_deductions > gti.
            # For simplicity, let's cap individual deductions proportionally or sequentially if needed,
            # or rebuild the VI-A trace lines based on capped total_deductions.
            pass

        if total_deductions > gti:
            # Rebuild VI-A trace with capped total
            # Remove previous VI-A trace lines
            trace = [t for t in trace if t["clause"] not in ("Sec 80C", "Sec 80CCD(1B)", "Sec 80D")]
            total_deductions = gti
            if total_deductions > 0:
                trace.append({
                    "kind": "income",
                    "description": "Chapter VI-A deductions (capped at Gross Total Income)",
                    "amount": str(-total_deductions),
                    "clause": "Sec 80A(2)"
                })

    taxable_income_unrounded = gti - total_deductions
    if taxable_income_unrounded < 0:
        taxable_income_unrounded = Decimal('0')

    # 6. Sec 288A - Rounding of total income
    total_income = round_nearest_ten(taxable_income_unrounded)
    income_rounding_diff = total_income - taxable_income_unrounded
    if income_rounding_diff != 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "income",
            "description": "Rounding adjustment to total income",
            "amount": str(income_rounding_diff),
            "clause": "Sec 288A"
        })

    # 7. Tax computation
    if is_new:
        slabs = SLABS_NEW
    else:
        if age >= 80:
            slabs = SLABS_OLD_SUPER_SENIOR
        elif age >= 60:
            slabs = SLABS_OLD_SENIOR
        else:
            slabs = SLABS_OLD_UNDER_60

    base_tax, slab_trace_lines = compute_slab_tax(total_income, slabs)
    for desc, amt, clause in slab_trace_lines:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": desc,
            "amount": str(amt),
            "clause": clause
        })

    current_tax = base_tax

    # 8. Sec 87A Rebate
    rebate = Decimal('0')
    if is_new:
        if total_income <= REBATE_INCOME_LIMIT_NEW:
            rebate = min(current_tax, REBATE_MAX_NEW)
        else:
            # Marginal relief (new regime only)
            excess_income = total_income - REBATE_INCOME_LIMIT_NEW
            if current_tax > excess_income:
                rebate = current_tax - excess_income
    else:
        if total_income <= REBATE_INCOME_LIMIT_OLD:
            rebate = min(current_tax, REBATE_MAX_OLD)

    if rebate > 0:
        current_tax -= rebate
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": "Rebate under Section 87A",
            "amount": str(-rebate),
            "clause": "Sec 87A"
        })

    if current_tax < 0:
        current_tax = Decimal('0')

    # 9. Surcharge and Surcharge Marginal Relief
    surcharge_thresholds = SURCHARGE_THRESHOLDS
    surcharge_rates = SURCHARGE_RATES_NEW if is_new else SURCHARGE_RATES_OLD
    if is_new:
        # cap at 25% (index 2 in old rates is 25%, index 3 is 37%)
        # SURCHARGE_RATES_NEW already has 25% at the 5cr band
        pass

    applicable_surcharge_rate = Decimal('0')
    applicable_threshold = Decimal('0')
    for idx, threshold in enumerate(surcharge_thresholds):
        if total_income > threshold:
            applicable_surcharge_rate = surcharge_rates[idx]
            applicable_threshold = threshold

    surcharge = current_tax * applicable_surcharge_rate
    if surcharge > 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": f"Surcharge at {applicable_surcharge_rate * 100}%",
            "amount": str(surcharge),
            "clause": "First Schedule"
        })

    # Surcharge Marginal Relief
    if applicable_threshold > 0:
        # Tax + Surcharge on actual income
        tax_plus_surcharge = current_tax + surcharge

        # Tax on threshold income
        # Need to compute tax on threshold income using same regime/slabs/rebate
        base_tax_thresh, _ = compute_slab_tax(applicable_threshold, slabs)
        # Rebate does not apply above threshold limits (12L new, 5L old)
        tax_at_thresh = base_tax_thresh

        # Surcharge rate AT the threshold
        # Find rate that applies at the threshold
        thresh_rate = Decimal('0')
        for idx, threshold in enumerate(surcharge_thresholds):
            if applicable_threshold > threshold:
                thresh_rate = surcharge_rates[idx]

        surcharge_at_thresh = tax_at_thresh * thresh_rate
        max_tax_surcharge = tax_at_thresh + surcharge_at_thresh + (total_income - applicable_threshold)

        if tax_plus_surcharge > max_tax_surcharge:
            surcharge_relief = tax_plus_surcharge - max_tax_surcharge
            surcharge -= surcharge_relief
            trace.append({
                "kind": "tax",
                "description": "Marginal relief on surcharge",
                "amount": str(-surcharge_relief),
                "clause": "First Schedule"
            })

    tax_after_surcharge = current_tax + surcharge

    # 10. Health and Education Cess
    cess = tax_after_surcharge * CESS_RATE
    if cess > 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": "Health and education cess at 4%",
            "amount": str(cess),
            "clause": "Finance Act"
        })

    tax_unrounded = tax_after_surcharge + cess

    # 11. Sec 288B - Rounding of tax
    tax_payable = round_nearest_ten(tax_unrounded)
    tax_rounding_diff = tax_payable - tax_unrounded
    if tax_rounding_diff != 0:
        trace.append({
            "kind": "tax",
            "description": "Rounding adjustment to tax payable",
            "amount": str(tax_rounding_diff),
            "clause": "Sec 288B"
        })

    return int(total_income), int(tax_payable), trace


def compute(inp: dict) -> dict:
    old_income, old_tax, old_trace = compute_regime(is_new=False, inp=inp)
    new_income, new_tax, new_trace = compute_regime(is_new=True, inp=inp)

    return {
        "old": {
            "total_income": old_income,
            "tax_payable": old_tax,
            "trace": old_trace
        },
        "new": {
            "total_income": new_income,
            "tax_payable": new_tax,
            "trace": new_trace
        }
    }
